node.title: DLI ell=2 weight-6 split-16 counterfixture
node.statement: In GF(65537), an exact order-1024 subgroup contains the reduced antipodal-free six-set of exponents {0,180,211,585,852,903}; both its first and third odd moments vanish. The triple-cubic router guards hold, and v_2(65537-1)=16. Thus order-1024 splitting, or any blanket split threshold at most 2^16, does not imply emptiness of the (ell,w)=(2,6) slot. This is not an official counterexample because the official ambient split requires v_2(q-1)>=41.
